meaning.en: A group of things arranged by category; a classification.
meaning.vi: Một nhóm những thứ được sắp xếp theo danh mục; một phân loại.

meaning.en: The process of sorting or arranging things into categories or classes.
meaning.vi: Quá trình phân loại hoặc sắp xếp mọi thứ thành các loại hoặc lớp.

sentences.en: It should be noted that the categorization of gender identity disorder as a mental illness has been a point of some contention among mental health professionals.

sentences.en: However, prior to this fairly recent categorization, the Samba was enjoyed in many different forms, usually not as a partner dance.
